question: What ritual action follows after satiating the primordial Kālikā?
premises: The primordial Kālikā has been satiated
An offering is to be made afterward
The Vaṭukas are the recipients of the offering
inference: After satiating the primordial Kālikā, one should offer bali to the Vaṭukas
plain_english: Having satiated the primordial Kālikā, one should offer bali to the Vaṭukas.
